$comment: zynkr-ops-weekly PRIVATE runtime config. Copy to ~/.config/zynkr/ops-weekly.json (never commit). Every value below is a placeholder.

space.name: <space display name>
space.$note: The spaces/ prefix is REQUIRED — get_messages rejects a bare id.

doc.archive_tab_id: <tab id of the archive tab, e.g. t.abc123>
doc.$note: Sections are named by MEETING day (Thursday), not by report day (Monday). The archive tab MUST be a sibling tab in THIS Doc: carryover.py reads all tabs as one stream, so a separate file resets every ↻N週 streak.

chat_ids.$note: The ONLY hardcoded map in this skill. Chat gives no email field at all; the Doc gives email and no id. TWO key forms are valid, because the MCP resolves a sender to a DISPLAY NAME when that person is in the account's personal Contacts and leaves everyone else as users/<id>. Key each person by whichever form their messages actually arrive as -- keeping both is harmless and survives a contact being added later.

non_reporting_members.$note: In the space but deliberately outside the report + chase lists.

main_tracker.$note: overdue items + status; snapshot copies this tab. cycle keeps one half-year's item numbers apart from the next tracker's.

ledger.epoch_week: <ISO week of the first snapshot, e.g. 2026-W40>
ledger.$note: The machine-owned Weekly Ledger (SKB-044, references/ledger.md). NEVER change epoch_week after the first snapshot: every week's rows are computed from it.

routine.$recap_audience: owner = the account alone (default, and what a missing value means); team = every address in reporters. Switch to team once the owner has seen a recap.
routine.$apply_mode: shadow = apply records the owner's decisions in the Ledger and writes nothing to the Main Tracker (default, and what any other value means); live = writes approved changes (Phase 3b — refused until it ships).
